heroSummary: Federal Way Public Schools begins the 2028–29 school year on Wednesday, August 30. Kindergarten Connection conferences and half days continue through September 7. Friday early releases begin September 22, and the scheduled last day is Thursday, June 14, with early dismissal.
calendarNotes: The 2028–29 calendar is the only reviewed FWPS year that begins in August. Kindergarten begins with Connection conferences and half days. Selected-Friday early releases do not begin until September 22. Scholar-Led Conferences close school in November and April. January 8 is a two-hour late start after Winter Break. Seniors finish June 7. May 25, June 15, June 18, and June 20 are conditional snow make-up dates, with Juneteenth on June 19 between the final two dates.

customSections.label: FWPS 2028–29 Shortened-Day Guide
customSections.content: The first selected-Friday release does not occur until September 22, more than three weeks after the August 30 opening. Families should use the exact list instead of applying a blanket every-Friday rule.

customSections.label: June 2029 Schedule: Last Day, Snow Dates & Juneteenth
customSections.content: Seniors finish June 7, and the scheduled last day for other students is June 14, with early dismissal. June 15, 18, and 20 are conditional snow make-up dates, while June 19 is Juneteenth. This is not one continuous make-up range: the holiday remains a separate no-school date.

customSections.label: February 16 Source Note
customSections.content: FWPS marks February 16 as a no-school date on the official PDF but does not name the reason. MySchoolDates leaves the date unnamed rather than inferring a holiday or break.

whatsNew.title: What’s Different in the 2028–29 FWPS Calendar?
content: The school year begins August 30, moving the opening from September into August.
Friday early releases begin later, on September 22.
Winter Break shifts to December 25–January 5, and the scheduled last day moves to June 14.

calendarFaqs.q: When does Federal Way Public Schools start in 2028?
calendarFaqs.a: The official FWPS calendar lists Wednesday, August 30, 2028, as the first day. Kindergarten Connection conferences and half days run August 30 through September 7.

calendarFaqs.q: When do FWPS Friday early releases begin in 2028–29?
calendarFaqs.a: The first selected-Friday early release is September 22, 2028. The PDF shows 28 selected Fridays; holidays, conferences, professional development, and other exceptions interrupt the pattern.

calendarFaqs.q: When is FWPS Winter Break in 2028–29?
calendarFaqs.a: Winter Break runs December 25, 2028, through January 5, 2029. School resumes Monday, January 8, with a two-hour late start.

calendarFaqs.q: When is FWPS Spring Break in 2029?
calendarFaqs.a: Spring Break runs April 9–13, 2029. Scholar-Led Conferences are separate no-school dates on April 5–6 before the weekend leading into break.

calendarFaqs.q: When is the last day of FWPS in 2029?
calendarFaqs.a: The scheduled last day is Thursday, June 14, 2029, with early dismissal. June 15, 18, and 20 remain no-school days unless FWPS activates them for snow make-up.

calendarFaqs.q: Is June 15–20 one continuous FWPS make-up period?
calendarFaqs.a: No. June 15, 18, and 20 are individual conditional snow make-up dates. June 19 is the Juneteenth holiday, and the weekend separates some of these dates.

sourceReviewSummary: Reviewed against the official FWPS calendar page, district profile, and the English plus seven translated 2028–29 calendar PDFs.
sourceReviewDetails: The English PDF was visually checked so the color-coded first day, releases, closures, senior date, last day, and make-up dates were captured correctly.
The selected-Friday list reflects only green early-release cells; it does not assume every Friday is shortened.
The unnamed orange February 16 cell is recorded conservatively as a no-school date rather than assigning an unsupported holiday name.
Make-up dates remain conditional, and school-specific bell, graduation, and emergency details require FWPS confirmation.
